=== VERIFYING A MEMORY ISSUE ===
"Memory issues often result in error messages such as the following"

Exact SparkException:
"SparkException: Job aborted due to stage failure: Task 3 in stage 0.0 failed 4 times, most recent failure: Lost task 3.3 in stage 0.0 (TID 30) (10.139.64.114 executor 4): ExecutorLostFailure (executor 4 exited caused by one of the running tasks) Reason: Remote RPC client disassociated."

Diagnostic test: "double the memory per core to see if it impacts your problem."
"It's the ratio of cores to memory that matters here. If it takes longer to fail with the extra memory or doesn't fail at all, that's a good sign that you're on the right track."

=== SIX CAUSES (with links) ===
1. Too few shuffle partitions → https://www.databricks.com/discover/pages/optimize-data-workloads-guide#data-spilling
2. Large broadcast → https://www.databricks.com/discover/pages/optimize-data-workloads-guide#broadcast-hash
3. UDFs → /aws/en/udf/
4. Window function without PARTITION BY → /aws/en/sql/language-manual/sql-ref-window-functions
5. Skew → https://www.databricks.com/discover/pages/optimize-data-workloads-guide#data-skewness
6. Streaming State → https://spark.apache.org/docs/latest/structured-streaming-programming-guide.html#state-store
